description: Static marketing site for muush, a technology solution studio. Landing and About pages, in Spanish and English.

features.name: design_tokens_and_logos
features.title: Design tokens (colors, typography) and logo assets
features.description: Replace the placeholder color and typography tokens in src/styles/global.css with the real values from the muush branding book (documented in docs/business/branding.md), and wire the three official isotipo SVG variants into the project as usable assets, mapped for the three background contexts the branding rules define (light/bone background, dark/ink background, on Red 400).
acceptance: Color custom properties in src/styles/global.css use the exact 5-step hex values from docs/business/branding.md for red, wine, ink and bone (not the placeholder 10-step scale)
The Tailwind theme (@theme inline) exposes the updated ramps as utility classes
font-poppins is scoped to logo/wordmark use only; font-instrument is the default for everything else, matching docs/business/branding.md
The three isotipo SVGs (bone-background, ink-background, red-background variants) are available in the project and selectable/renderable for their documented background context
pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build all pass

features.name: primitive_ui_layer
features.title: Primitive UI layer: fluid type scale + GlassPanel, Radar, Wordmark, Lockup, Pill, Botón primario, LinkArrow, SocialIcon
features.description: Implement the dependency-free primitive layer that every landing/Nosotros section composes from. All measurements come from docs/business/landing/design-extract.md, which holds the values extracted directly from the .pen design file — read that file, do NOT attempt to open the .pen (the Pencil MCP bridge is not available to subagents). Scope covers: (a) a fluid typography + spacing scale in src/styles/global.css using clamp(), so the desktop/mobile difference is handled by tokens instead of breakpoints; (b) eight .astro components with zero dependencies on each other except Pill→Radar and Lockup→Isotipo+Wordmark; (c) normalizing the three social SVG icons per decisions-open.md. No page, layout, section, card, or form component is built here.
acceptance: src/styles/global.css exposes a fluid type scale (display, h1, h2, h3, lead, body, label, meta) and spacing/radius tokens using clamp(), covering the desktop→mobile ranges in design-extract.md § 9, so no component needs a media query for sizing
Eight components exist in src/components/: GlassPanel, Radar, Wordmark, Lockup, Pill, BotonPrimario, LinkArrow, SocialIcon — all .astro, all static, zero client-side JS
GlassPanel supports the 6 variants in design-extract.md § 1 (red-strong, red-soft, bone-strong, bone, bone-faint, dark) with their exact fill/stroke/blur values
Radar supports the 3 sizes in design-extract.md § 2 (sm 20/14/7, md 30/20/12, sm-alt 22/16/10)

BotonPrimario supports the 3 size variants in design-extract.md § 4 (nav, hero, submit) and its LED border is the exact 3-stop conic gradient red-400 → bone-100 → #cf3247 (NOT wine), animated in CSS only, honoring prefers-reduced-motion
Wordmark can render both official lockups: 'muush' and 'muush.dev'
The three social SVGs are normalized per decisions-open.md: square viewBox, fill=currentColor (so they inherit bone-100, not pure white), no embedded <style>/<defs>/DOCTYPE
Every visual value comes from a design token — no hardcoded hex or px literals in component markup (Constitution Article IV)
No page, layout, section, card, or form component is created or modified — same scoping precedent as feature 001
pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build all pass
